title: Capture Notification Event
description: Emitted by capture workloads when a unit of work completes (one disc ripped, one scan session closed). Consumed by the notification relay for fan-out to downstream systems.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Consumers must check this before parsing.

source.description: Which capture workload produced this event.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of event emission.

output_path.description: Absolute path on the NAS where the captured output was written. Consumers use this to locate the files.

media_type.description: The type of media captured. Used by downstream pipelines to route processing.

metadata.description: Source-specific metadata. Fields are nullable -- optical ripper populates disc fields, scanner populates scan fields.

title.description: Media title from metadata lookup (OMDb for video, MusicBrainz for audio). Null for data discs and scans.

year.description: Release year from metadata lookup. Null when not applicable.

source_device.description: Device identifier matching the NFD label value (e.g. 'pioneer-bdr-xs07uhd', 'epson-ds-1630').

disc_label.description: Volume label read from the disc. Null for scans.

page_count.description: Number of pages in a scan session. Null for disc rips.

session_id.description: Scan session identifier matching the session directory name. Null for disc rips.

node_name.description: Kubernetes node name where the capture workload ran. Useful for debugging and auditing.
